payload.title: the architect objective's sign
payload.body: Ruled: the architect position's objective is a new objective value `conceptual-integrity` (Brooks's sign; the architect archetype already calls the position 'keeper of conceptual integrity'). Cold probe, two models each, with only 'Objective: <value>': conceptual-integrity decoded as guarding one coherent design others build to, neither building, testing nor merging; design-fidelity decoded as an implementer serving someone else's design; realization ⟨artifact ≅ design⟩ as a builder; delivery ⟨end-to-end integrated green⟩ as build-test-merge. The value carries no gloss; its sign carries it. `delivery` stays in the catalog for positions that do integrate.
